# `Input` of RGSS2 measured on the original runtime of VX (RGSS202E 2.0.2.1 and 2.0.0.1,
# 2026-10-12, report vx-v1-sprite-REPORT.md section 7): 12084 updates of the real module
# driven through the keyboard, in 25 scripted sequences and three random ones.
#
#   stream NAME                 everything is released and 8 updates pass, whose answers are
#                               not listed; what the state keeps beyond that carries over
#   update P T R DIR4 DIR8      one `Input.update` with the buttons of P held, and the answers
#                               after it: `press?`, `trigger?` and `repeat?` as one digit for
#                               each of DOWN LEFT RIGHT UP C B A X SHIFT, then `dir4`, `dir8`
#   keep P T R DIR4 DIR8        a frame without `Input.update`: the answers as they are
#   ... xN                      the line stands N times
#
# The Shift key holds A and SHIFT, so both digits are set together.
